a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children invent a game in which helping counts more than speed.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One child prefers watching and becomes an enthusiastic scorekeeper.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Their imaginative maze delights visitors but confuses adults.

c2.text: The quiet area attracts storytellers and becomes louder than expected.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) demonstrates a childhood game nobody remembers.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (elder), a competitive grandparent, loses spectacularly and demands a rematch.
